## What changes
Describe the observable behavior and why it matters.

## Ownership and contracts
Lane: A agent / B repo / C global (B/C may both work frontend)
Shared files or API/config changes agreed with:
Other lane handoff (if any):
Shared frontend files claimed/released, and next editor:
Current integration captain (B initially; explicit B/C handoff):

## Evidence
Commands actually run and results:
Fixture / mocked transport / live:
Model, snapshot and check references for live claims:
Remaining limits or blocked checks:

## Review
- [ ] Only intended files; no credentials, runtime data or personal pass data
- [ ] Existing workflow, isolation and approval guards preserved
- [ ] Failure/loading/empty states and unknown usage remain honest
- [ ] Commit subjects and PR title follow CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] One teammate reviewed; integrator owns merge and final demo checks
